title: New PS Portal Announced, Future-Proofed with Internal Storage and Only for Japan
summary:
New version in black is exclusive to Japan.

Sony has today announced a new model of the PS Portal will be future-proofed with the addition of internal storage. The new version is launching on 10th December 2026 at the same price as the current model (¥39,980), but only in Japan.

Just like the Japan-specific PS5 console Sony sells, this new PS Portal model can only be set to the Japanese language and use a PSN account from the Japan region.

title: 2 Upcoming PS Plus Extra, Premium Games Announced Early
summary:
In the Japanese region at least.

Sony has revealed two PS5 games that will be joining PS Plus Extra in the coming months. On the Japanese side of the PlayStation Blog, it's confirmed the following additions:

  • Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake (PS5) — From November 2026
  • Dynasty Warriors: Origins (PS5) — From December 2026

While the confirmation does come from the Japanese PlayStation Blog, the game additions are generally universal, so the chances of the two titles being included in the worldwide PS Plus Extra updates are high. The lineup for November 2026, at least, is being revealed this Wednesday, 11th November 2026.
